trajectory.content:
Which finding is in this chest X-ray?
Options: {"A": "left base pulmonary atelectasis", "B": "right base pulmonary atelectasis"}

{"calls":[{"tool":"chest_xray_expert","args":{"question":"Describe the location of any atelectasis or opacity in this chest X-ray, specifically noting if it is at the left base or right base."}}],"reason":"Determine the laterality and location of the atelectasis to distinguish between options A and B."}

{"calls":[{"tool":"llava_med_qa","args":{"question":"Is there atelectasis or opacity at the right base or left base in this chest X-ray? Specify the side."}}],"reason":"Cross-validate the laterality of the basal finding with an independent model to confirm right vs left base atelectasis."}

{"calls":[{"tool":"medvlm_r1","args":{"question":"Describe any basal opacity or atelectasis in this chest X-ray and specify whether it is on the patient's left or right side."}}],"reason":"Obtain a third independent assessment of the laterality to resolve conflict between previous tools."}

{"calls":[{"tool":"llava_rad","args":{"question":"Identify the side of any basal atelectasis or opacity in this chest X-ray: left base or right base?"}}],"reason":"Obtain another independent model assessment to resolve conflicting prior outputs regarding laterality."}

{"calls":[{"tool":"medgemma","args":{"question":"Is there atelectasis or opacity at the left base or right base in this chest X-ray? Specify the side."}}],"reason":"Obtain another independent model assessment to resolve conflicting prior outputs regarding laterality."}

{"answer":"B. right base pulmonary atelectasis","reason":"Two independent models (chest_xray_expert and medgemma) identified opacity/atelectasis at the right base, while other models were non-specific or negative."}
Historical reference: B. right base pulmonary atelectasis
